dict.string: Haven Connect uses Bluetooth to communicate with health monitoring devices like EEG headbands, heart rate monitors, and pulse oximeters.
Haven Connect uses Bluetooth to communicate with health monitoring devices.
Haven Connect uses the microphone for breathing analysis in health applications.
Haven Connect uses the camera for heart rate detection via photoplethysmography (PPG) in health applications.
Location permission is required by iOS for Bluetooth device discovery. Haven Connect does not track your location.
